# cattery

cattery — quick-start NixOS configurations with room-based module bundles

- [cattery](/index): Quick-start NixOS configurations — choose a room, get a complete system
- [Quick Start](/quick-start): Get started with cattery — NixOS, home-manager, nix-darwin, WSL
- [Rooms](/rooms): Pre-configured module bundles — enable one room, get a complete system
- [Modules](/modules): Complete module reference for cattery — all 244+ modules with options
- [Secrets & agenix](/secrets): Encrypted secret management with agenix — host-specific, shared, and user-scoped secrets
- [Contributing](/contributing): How to contribute to cattery-modules
